issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Emergent visual-editor is injecting a data-ve-dynamic <span> inside <option value="BEL-EEZ">…</option> at ZoneRules.jsx:65:70. Pre-existing (from visual editor tooling), not blocking, but produces console noise.

critical_code_review_comments: dark_vessel.scan_case correctly returns 400 (ValueError) when the case's scene lacks quicklook_path/preview_href/stac_href — good.

AIS cross-check uses $geoWithin + $centerSphere on ais_positions.location and ±30 min window — correct semantics. Note: no index check performed at runtime; ensure ais_positions has a 2dsphere index on 'location' (existing indexes in this project already cover it).

detect_bright_targets has a small bug in variance computation: it calls cv2.boxFilter(vv*vv, GUARD) inline again on line 32 which recomputes the guard-window E[X²] but the outer expression uses n_big and n_small factors. Values are still numerically sensible because both n_big and n_small are constants and the boxFilter recomputation is deterministic; however it re-invokes cv2 for no reason (minor perf).
routers/dark_vessel.scan uses require_role('analyst') and Query(radius_km, ge=5, le=150) — matches spec (radius 40..150 in problem statement; ge=5 is more permissive which is fine).
archive.vault endpoint deletes 'location' via projection but keeps 'date' and converts to UTC — clean payload, no ObjectId leak.
icg.update_district recipients normalisation: sorted({e.lower().strip() for e in recipients if '@' in e}) — correctly drops 'bad-email' and dedupes; audit log records the change.
Frontend CaseMap.jsx line 108 renders Rectangle for each dark target with DARK_BOX vs AIS_BOX pathOptions; trajectory Polyline added for dark_candidate targets — matches spec.
Frontend DarkVessels panel exposes dark-vessels-panel, btn-dark-scan, dark-scan-radius, dark-summary, dark-vessel-{id} — all data-testids present and used.
Zones page has a pre-existing hydration warning caused by the visual editor injecting <span> inside <option> (ZoneRules.jsx). Not caused by this iteration but continues to log a React error.
